learning_objective: 🎯 Let's discover the exciting shapes of the Earth's surface, like tall snowy peaks and flat green lands, and see how people live there!

main_concepts.concept_title: ⛰️ Mountains: The Roof of the World
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Mountains are very tall, rocky landforms that reach high into the sky. Because it is very cold at the top, many mountains are covered in beautiful white snow.
Imagine a mountain that had its pointy top sliced off to be completely flat. That is a plateau! It is raised high up but has a flat surface like a giant table.
Plains are large, flat areas of land. Because the ground is usually very soft and fertile here, it is the best place to grow crops and build big cities.

fun_activity.title: 🏜️ Clay Crafter
fun_activity.instructions: Grab some playdough or clay and try building the three main landforms on a plate: a pointy mountain, a flat-topped plateau, and a smooth, low plain.

quick_recap: ⭐ Mountains are steep and high landforms, often with snowy peaks.
⭐ Plateaus are raised lands that are flat on top, just like a table.
⭐ Plains are flat, low lands where it is very easy to grow food and build homes.
